headline: Delhi-Bound IndiGo Flight Makes Emergency Landing in Goa
summary: An IndiGo flight heading to Delhi was forced to return to Manohar International Airport following a mid-air engine failure. All 229 passengers and crew members landed safely, though the incident caused brief panic onboard.

headline: Goa Government Drops Proposed Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the state will not introduce the controversial religious anti-conversion bill. The decision follows internal pushback and widespread public backlash.

headline: 90% of Crimes in Goa Committed by Migrants, Claims CM
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the vast majority of crimes in the state are committed by migrant residents. He urged locals to verify the backgrounds of their tenants and domestic workers.

headline: FDA to Re-Inspect Canteens and Eateries Across Goa
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the Food and Drugs Administration will conduct fresh safety and hygiene audits of food establishments in the state. The move aims to ensure strict compliance with health standards.

headline: MLA Questions Low Conviction Rate Despite High Crime Detection
summary: MLA Viresh Borkar questioned the state government over Goa's low crime conviction rate of 5.85 percent, contrasting it with a high detection rate of nearly 99 percent. He called for better police investigation and prosecution efforts.

headline: Supreme Court Cancels Bail for Goa Nightclub Owners
summary: The Supreme Court has ordered three owners of a Goa nightclub to surrender within two weeks after upholding a High Court decision to cancel their bail. The case relates to a devastating fire incident at their establishment.

headline: E20 Petrol Rolled Out Safe and Violation-Free Across Goa
summary: Ethanol-blended E20 petrol is now available at nearly 90 fuel stations across Goa, with the government reporting no compliance issues during inspections. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant assured that the fuel is safe and has received no widespread complaints.

headline: New Bill to Fast-Track Land-Grabbing Cases in Goa
summary: The state government has introduced a legislative bill in the Assembly to accelerate the resolution of land-grabbing cases. The move aims to protect property owners and deter fraudulent transactions.

headline: Two Arrested for Extorting Goa Real Estate Firm
summary: Police have arrested two individuals for allegedly attempting to extort money from a prominent real estate firm. The extortion attempt was connected to an upcoming township project in Goa.

headline: Goa Tops Travel Searches for Upcoming Long Weekends
summary: Travel platform Agoda revealed that Goa is the most-searched domestic destination for the Rakshabandhan and Janmashtami long weekends. The state continues to lead the country in holiday accommodation interest.

headline: Congress Leader Objects to 'Goa Congress' Name
summary: A Congress leader has raised concerns over using the name 'Goa Congress' for political activities. The objection stems from a desire to maintain the official identity of the party.

headline: Goa Repays Debt and Avoids Open Market Borrowing
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that Goa has successfully repaid Rs 1,103 crore in debt and has not borrowed any money from the open market so far this fiscal year. This financial strategy aims to strengthen the state's economic health.

headline: Speaker Warns Opposition to Maintain Assembly Decorum
summary: The Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly has cautioned opposition members to maintain proper conduct during the sessions. The warning follows disruptive exchanges and protests in the House.

headline: Porvorim Shootout Case Transferred to Crime Branch
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant confirmed that the investigation into the recent Porvorim shootout has been handed over to the Crime Branch. The transfer aims to ensure a thorough and specialized probe into the incident.

headline: Two Opposition MLAs Marshaled Out of Assembly After Protests
summary: Opposition leaders Yuri Alemao and Viresh Borkar were forcibly removed from the Goa Assembly by marshals. The action was taken after they protested against the Speaker's decision to disallow a query.

headline: Goa to Regularize Contractual Education Staff by October
summary: The state government has announced plans to regularize contractual education employees who have completed 10 years of service. This process is expected to be finalized by October this year.

headline: 16 Bills Introduced on First Day of Goa Assembly Session
summary: The Goa Legislative Assembly saw the introduction of 16 different legislative bills on the very first day of its session. These proposals cover various aspects of state governance and administration.

headline: Goa Cyber Fraud Money Converted to Foreign Currency
summary: The Enforcement Directorate revealed that funds stolen through a major cyber fraud scheme in Goa were illegally converted into foreign currencies. The agency is tracking financial trails to uncover the full extent of the scam.

headline: Cabinet Approves Joint Ventures for Goa Housing Board
summary: The Goa Cabinet has approved a bill that allows the Goa Housing Board to enter into joint venture agreements. This move is intended to boost development and housing projects in the state.

headline: Goa Seeks Rs 476 Crore for Rejuvenating Khazan Lands
summary: The state government has requested Rs 476 crore from the central government to fund the restoration of its unique Khazan lands. The initiative aims to protect these traditional eco-cultural farming zones from degradation.

headline: Rise in Dolphin and Porpoise Deaths Along Goa's Coast
summary: A growing number of dolphin and porpoise carcasses found along the Goa coastline has raised alarms among environmentalists. The trend highlights critical gaps in current marine mammal conservation policies.

headline: Actress Rupali Ganguly Expresses Her Preference for Goa
summary: Television actress Rupali Ganguly shared that despite vacationing in the Maldives with her family, she still prefers Goa as a holiday destination. Her comments highlight the state's enduring appeal to top celebrities.

headline: ST Reservation Talk Sparks Seat Shifts in South Goa
summary: Discussions surrounding Scheduled Tribe seat reservations have triggered political realignments in South Goa. Candidates and parties are adjusting their strategies in anticipation of shifting electoral boundaries.
